title: neutrino.semantic-capability-registry
description: The authoritative machine-readable capability registry for the M7 intake seam (): one record per closed semantic capability, pinned to semanticProfileVersion. A pure projection of neutrino::knownSemanticFeatures() (the single source of truth) emitted by `neutrino-translate --capability-registry`, byte-matched by CI, and published in the core-contract bundle with its digest so a package-only producer/verifier can obtain and independently validate it. Each record carries only metadata the closed vocabulary authoritatively supports — the stable id (<dimension>:<value> feature string), its dimension (role) and value, and its category (primitive/obligation type, from semanticFeatureCategory, the same rule the L2->L1 reduction checks l1_feature kind against). The registry introduces no capability of its own and no domain/backend identity. The M7 intake classifier anchors executable reductions BY IDENTITY against this registry, never re-listing capabilities. Fail-closed (additionalProperties:false).

semanticProfileVersion.description: The closed semantic-profile contract version (VersionInfo.h kSemanticProfileVersion) this registry is pinned to; an artifact produced under a different version fails closed at the intake seam.

capabilities.description: The closed, sorted-by-id, unique set of capability records.

id.description: The stable capability identity: the closed <dimension>:<value> feature string.

dimension.description: The capability role: the token before ':' in the id.

value.description: The capability value: the token after ':' in the id.

category.description: The capability type: 'obligation' for constraint dimensions the coordination must uphold (invariant:/replay:), 'primitive' otherwise.
